entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalking necromancer bound by a pact with four demons, who has killed two of them using the Chain Veil and is haunted by its whispering voices.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An evil artifact of fine chain mesh from Shandalar's Onakke, which empowers Liliana but whispers constantly and refuses to let go of her.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon, Liliana's former patron who sent her to fetch the Chain Veil and whom she killed with its power.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: The second of Liliana's four demonic masters, whom she killed on Innistrad with the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: A nature-magic planeswalker whom Liliana infected with shadow and who hunted her across worlds to Innistrad.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's brother, whose killing planted the root of destruction in her and whom she tries to avoid following into the void.

entities.name: Raven Man
entities.description: A raven that watches Liliana from a building in the Onakke vision and is the first creature to notice her.

entities.name: Onakke
entities.description: An ancient civilization of horned or tusked ogres of Shandalar, wiped out by a purplish cloud in a vision, whose spirits haunt the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Four Demons
entities.description: Four demons from four planes with whom Liliana made a contract etched on her skin.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane where the Chain Veil and the Onakke catacomb are found.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where Liliana killed Griselbrand and fought Garruk.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The unending chaos between planes through which planeswalkers travel.

entities.name: Onakke Catacomb
entities.description: An ancient catacomb or temple on Shandalar where the Chain Veil lay, partly crumbled after Liliana's battle with Garruk.

events.summary: Liliana arrives on Shandalar, tormented by the Chain Veil's voices, and heads for the Onakke catacomb she has visited before.
events.quote: all she could hear was the veil.

events.summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill her demon patron Kothophed and then Griselbrand, and her earlier ill-fated visit to learn of the Onakke.
events.quote: Instead of bringing it back to him like a good little retriever, she'd used its power to kill him.

events.summary: Liliana recalls her first visit, when she killed her horse's attacker and used the veil to infect Garruk with shadow, after which he hunted her to Innistrad.
events.quote: She'd used it to infect him with shadow, polluting his nature magic with the touch of death.

events.summary: At the catacomb Liliana kills a guarding angel, who warns her of the Onakke and that she is a vessel.
events.quote: She punctuated her words with a killing wave of raw necromantic power that flayed flesh from the angel's bones

events.summary: Liliana's tattoos bleed as the Onakke voices fall silent, and she sees a vision of the Onakke city in which a purplish cloud obliterates the ogres.
events.quote: A cascade of meteors streaked across the sky as the Onakke were utterly obliterated before her eyes.

events.summary: Liliana tries to return the Chain Veil to its altar but cannot let go of it.
events.quote: She tried to open her hand, to let the thing drop, but her fingers wouldn't obey her will.

events.summary: Liliana raises an Onakke skeleton to take the veil, but it will not leave and she destroys it; the veil ends up hanging from her arm.
events.quote: She stared at the veil in horror as bones clattered to the floor all around her.

events.summary: An Onakke spirit calls her vessel and tells her the root planted when she killed her brother will bloom into destruction; it also says she acts to avoid following Josu into the void.
events.quote: Everything you've done has been to avoid following Josu into the void.

events.summary: Liliana drains the Chain Veil's power to extinguish the Onakke spirit at great pain but still cannot drop the veil.
events.quote: And like a snuffed candle flame, the spirit vanished.

events.summary: Liliana leaves Shandalar, still carrying the veil and its whispers, fearing she has taken into herself the thing she spent her life avoiding.
events.quote: she wondered if she had taken into herself the one thing she had spent her whole life trying to avoid.

relations.note: She killed her demon patron with the Chain Veil's power.
relations.quote: she'd used its power to kill him.

relations.note: She killed the second of her four demonic masters on Innistrad.
relations.quote: Then she took it to Innistrad and killed Griselbrand, the second of her four demonic masters.

relations.note: Garruk hunted her across worlds to make her lift his curse or take revenge.
relations.quote: And then Garruk had hunted her across the worlds, as far as Innistrad

relations.note: The Onakke spirit says the root was planted when she killed her brother.
relations.quote: The root that was planted in you so many years ago, when you killed your brother.

relations.note: She is bound by a contract etched on her skin to render services to four demons.
relations.quote: She made a pact with four demons from four different planes

relations.note: The Chain Veil is the Onakke's veil and haunted by their spirits.
relations.quote: We are beyond the reach of your magic,
